mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 145,000 (thousands of persons) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises above 145000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals an accommodative monetary policy combined with a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with tight labor market
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% year-over-year), consumer spending shifts toward essentials, reducing retail sector profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 4.0%.
